title: music_rights_v1
description: Every music cue is two separate rights, the composition and the master, held by different people and licensed separately. E&O carriers require both licences plus a complete cue sheet before they bind. The typical licence term field is what drives the Monitor cadence, because a licence that lapses quietly years after delivery is how a show ends up in syndication with sound alikes.

composition_rights_holder.description: Publisher or writer share holders. This is the synchronisation side.

master_rights_holder.description: Label or master owner. This is the master use side. Different party, separate negotiation, separate fee.

public_domain_status.description: Public domain in one territory is not public domain in all of them, which is why territories_verified exists as a separate field.

typical_license_term_years.description: Drives Monitor cadence. Inside the expiry window the watch tightens from quarterly to weekly so the production is alerted before the licence lapses rather than after.

estimated_fee_range_usd.description: Indicative only. Presented as a range and labelled as an estimate, never as a quote.

alternatives.description: Period appropriate cues with cleaner rights positions, offered when the requested cue is expensive or encumbered.
